title: Birdsey Group Named a 2026 Atlanta Business Chronicle Pacesetter
excerpt: Birdsey Group LLC has been named a 2026 Atlanta Business Chronicle Pacesetter, recognizing the firm as one of metro Atlanta’s fastest-growing privately held companies. The honor reflects Birdsey’s continued growth across its real estate platform and the disciplined commitment to Quality, Urgency, Accountability, Resilience, and Transparency that defines the Birdsey Standard.

children.text: Birdsey Group LLC has been recognized by the Atlanta Business Chronicle as a 2026 Pacesetter, an honor recognizing some of the fastest-growing privately held companies in metro Atlanta.

The annual Pacesetter Awards celebrate companies demonstrating significant growth. The 2026 rankings were based on a weighted average growth index measuring revenue and employee growth from 2023 through 2025.

For Birdsey Group, the recognition reflects more than expansion. It represents years of building the people, capabilities, and operating disciplines required to serve clients across an increasingly broad real estate platform.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Atlanta, Birdsey Group has grown into a national real estate consulting firm serving the real estate investment and finance industries. Its work spans underwriting, due diligence, asset management, field services, construction, property-related services, and other specialized capabilities supporting clients throughout the real estate lifecycle.
That growth has been accompanied by a deliberate commitment to what the company calls the Birdsey Standard: Quality, Urgency, Accountability, Resilience, and Transparency.
“Growth only matters if you can continue delivering at the standard your clients expect,”
said Sandford Birdsey, President and CEO of Birdsey Group.

“Quality means doing the work right. Urgency means understanding that our clients’ timelines matter. Accountability means owning the outcome. Resilience is what allows us to solve problems and keep moving when the work gets complicated. And transparency is how we build trust. Those principles have guided how we’ve built Birdsey Group, and they are the same principles that will guide where we go next.”

The emphasis on client service has been part of Birdsey Group’s operating philosophy from the beginning. The company describes its goal as becoming an extension of its clients’ teams by combining experience, responsiveness, disciplined analysis, and reliable execution.

As client needs have evolved, Birdsey Group has continued to broaden its capabilities while maintaining that personal attention. Expansion across commercial and residential real estate services, asset management, field services, and construction has allowed the organization to support more of the challenges its clients face without losing sight of the relationships behind the work.
For Birdsey, the significance of the 2026 Pacesetter Award is not simply the rate at which the organization has grown.
It is confirmation that disciplined growth, strong client relationships, and a clearly defined operating standard can scale together.
“We are proud of the recognition, but even more proud of the team behind it,”
“Our growth is the result of people who understand what our clients are counting on us to deliver and who take personal responsibility for delivering it well.”
Birdsey Group looks forward to continuing that work by expanding its expertise, strengthening its platform, and applying the Birdsey Standard to every client relationship and engagement.

Founded in 2004, Birdsey Group is a national real estate consulting firm headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company provides specialized services to the real estate investment and finance industries, supporting clients across underwriting, due diligence, asset management, field services, construction, and related real estate disciplines. Birdsey Group serves clients nationwide.
